open_points.subject: StandingGrant target node
open_points.text: grants a node of the flow's active version whose class is not `destructive`
open_points.question: What happens when the named node is a function node and therefore has no effect class?
options: Refuse grants for function nodes and allow only operation nodes
Treat a function node as `read` and create an unused grant
open_points.default_guess: Refuse the request because standing grants apply only to operation nodes.

open_points.subject: Effect authority outcome
open_points.text: The effect sent once, on the exact request the owner was shown or under the owner's grant
open_points.question: Does this outcome also permit a `draft-write` send under the flow activation, as the trigger and steps 2–3 require?
options: Add the flow activation as a third permitted authority
Require an approval or grant for `draft-write` too
Exclude `draft-write` sends from this stated outcome
open_points.default_guess: Treat the flow activation as the third permitted authority for an ordinary `draft-write` send.

open_points.subject: Installed-instance start check
open_points.text: a manifest record that cannot be read or fails a check of the record itself (A08 rule 5) stops the start naming it
open_points.question: Which A08 rule 5 operation-specific checks are run at startup when `check_installed_instances` has a service and selected instance but no operation name?
options: Check only service-level and selected-instance facts needed for header-collision validation
Validate every capability entry in a specified order
Do not validate capability entries until proposal, acceptance or send
open_points.default_guess: At startup, check only the service record and selected-instance facts needed to validate credential-header collisions; leave operation-specific checks to binding operations.
